# C001's credit made by a journal entry with no bank split, and INV-001
# spending it, each with a memo.
#
# The same entry `a_customers_credit_made_by_a_journal_entry.txt` makes, with
# its credit split's memo stated as "Attributed to Acme", and the same invoice
# `an_invoice_spending_the_journal_entrys_credit.txt` posts, with its credit
# block's memo stated as "Spent on INV-001".
#
# What this fixture produces, read into the book those two built: the credit
# split takes the block's memo, "Spent on INV-001". A block whose memo is the
# one the file writes on the bank split is a ledger an earlier release wrote and
# changes nothing, but this entry has no split off the receivable, so there is
# no bank split for the block to be stating.
#
# Load after `payment_roundtrip_accounts.txt` and those two fixtures.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_credit_blocks_memo_lands_on_a_journal_entrys_credit_with_no_bank_split.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

2026-01-06 * "Attributed to Acme"
	guid: "a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -50.00 CAD
		guid: "b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1"
		lot_owner: customer:C001
		memo: "Attributed to Acme"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable 50.00 CAD
		guid: "c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1"

invoice "INV-001"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 50
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 50.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-01-06
		txn_guid: "a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1"
		txn_split_guid: "b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1"
		memo: "Spent on INV-001"
